critical.fact: Global request_id deduplication collides across tenants; a different tenant can receive another tenant's settlement instead of its own.

major.fact: 28-day deletion without archive cannot satisfy 41-day reconciliation.

hard_negatives: Redis hot indexing is approved for settlement; PostgreSQL remains durable source
Rollback has an explicit failure trigger and owner
Load tests are planned, not falsely claimed complete

critical.fact: Unconditional overwrite permits an older event to regress shipment state; need a per-shipment version guard.
Logging a complete Authorization header violates the accepted credential logging prohibition.

hard_negatives: 8 hot days plus 73 archive days satisfy the 52-day lookup need under the approved restoration bound
Rollback and load targets are explicitly stated
Planned tests are not completed test results

grading.new_valid_findings: Validate against actual source; not being planted does not make a finding false.
grading.deduplication: Multiple manifestations of one root defect earn only one detection.
grading.unsupported_claim: A concrete factual premise asserted as existing/absent that is unsupported or contradicted by actual supplied source; conditional risks and questions are separate unless they contain a false factual premise.
grading.disagreement: Critical detection or unsupported factual claim disputes require independent adjudication. No release verdict until resolved.

memory.complete_contract: All eight answer fields correct, applicable decision cited, and ticket traced to actual durable evidence for a fresh receiver. A random matching keyword does not pass.

claims.parity: Observed fixed-suite no regression only; no statistical equivalence, causal indexing effect or general model superiority.
claims.efficiency: Report all assigned workflow calls and failures, include controller-dispatched reviewer usage exactly once, and condition any efficiency conclusion on matched task quality. No dollars without dated actual model/tier/cache prices.
